PDN-0178.summary: Remaining channel on metal layer for supply nets
PDN-0178.root_cause: Standard cell row fragmentation, illegal cut_rows or manual row destruction, or missing pitch alignment leaves an un-routable followpin channel between placed macros or voltage domain boundaries.
PDN-0178.remedy: Ensure row continuity across voltage regions; eliminate row pruning that creates dead gaps inside domains; align domain/macro boundaries to site row heights (e.g. 2.72µm in Sky130).

PDN-0179.root_cause: OpenROAD's pdngen channel repair mechanism could not bridge or close residual gaps in standard cell followpin rails (met1) across rows or macro halos.
PDN-0179.remedy: Check floorplan row definition: avoid destroying row segments inside active voltage domains or between macro edges where followpin rails are expected.

PDN-0209.root_cause: Power switch definition or instance has already been declared in UPF or previous PDN script invocation.
PDN-0209.remedy: Ensure idempotence before defining power switches or calling define_power_switch_cell.

UPF-0019.root_cause: Calling create_power_domain on an existing power domain without idempotence guards.
UPF-0019.remedy: Use the OpenROAD UPF compatibility shim layer to check if domain already exists before calling create_power_domain.

GPL-0302.root_cause: Standard cell area exceeds available core area, or target density is set unachievably high (>0.85).
GPL-0302.remedy: Expand core bounds, adjust core margins, or lower target density.

DPL-0036.root_cause: Cell overlap or unplaced instances that cannot be legalized due to local routing congestion or narrow macro corridors.
DPL-0036.remedy: Increase macro channel spacing to at least 15-20 tracks; verify macro halos are non-overlapping.
